name: claude-bridge
description: Claude Bridge: talk to your Claude Code sessions from the Claude app, voice mode included.

plugins.name: codebridge
plugins.description: Lets the Claude app (voice mode included) reach your Claude Code sessions: send requests, hear replies, answer questions, catch up, start, resume and fork sessions.

plugins.name: codebridge-app
plugins.description: The Claude app side as a plugin, for accounts that can't add a custom connector: the same Claude Bridge tools in chat and voice mode, signed in with your Claude Bridge key.
